name: Assembler
description: Builds every seat from its selected arm and reports which seats are built and, for each that is not, the line that says exactly what to pass or set. It runs nothing for a request.
purpose: Build the whole from the best-measured arm of every seat and report its coverage, with no glue written by the consumer.
approach: Resolve each seat's selected arm and its needs, build what can be built and report what is still pending.
out_of_scope: Running a request (The Self does that), deciding what a part does, and judging whether a response is good.
milestones: 1. The offline stage of metric-the-assembler has a counting result for at least two arms on the same cases. 2. The production stage of metric-the-assembler has a counting result for at least two arms on the same cases. 3. The selected arm is the one the cascade of metric-the-assembler chooses (rule S33).
measures_of_success: End-to-end pass rate on a production consumer.
outputs: Free text answered from what is remembered and from the web, held to its evidence, with the arms used.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself: it calls the entry points of the parts it uses.
usage_notes: No arm yet: the seat is defined and empty.

name: Integrity
description: Keeps the hub generic: claims match evidence, records match code, and only failures that are hidden are reported. Audits the hub for consumer wording and how stale its research is. A documented default is never an integrity finding.
purpose: Keep the whole honest and usable by any consumer: what the system says about itself and what it did matches the record.
approach: Scan the hub for consumer-specific strings and keep prompts as data the consumer passes in.
out_of_scope: Judging whether an answer to a person is good (Response Quality does that), fixing what it finds, and choosing which arm is best.
milestones: 1. Consumer-specific strings found by the scan: none (metric-system-integrity).
inputs: The terms that count as consumer wording.
outputs: Consumer-specific strings found, stale areas and the share of connections that need no code.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself: it calls the entry points of the parts it uses.
usage_notes: No arm yet: the seat is defined and empty.

name: Role Understanding
description: Each part of the system knows what it is for, what it hands on and what it leaves to the others, so no part does another part's work or hides a failure of its own.
purpose: Give every part a role in the whole that the part and the Assembler can both read.
approach: State each part's role as data the part and the Assembler can read, and compare what a part does with the role it states.
out_of_scope: Building the parts, and deciding which arm of a part is best.
milestones: 1. A part's behaviour matches the role the whole gives it (metric-role-understanding).
measures_of_success: A part's behaviour matches the role the whole gives it.
outputs: The role of a part (purpose, what it is not responsible for, who owns that) read from its record.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself: it calls the entry points of the parts it uses.
usage_notes: No arm yet: the seat is defined and empty.
